title: List ledger packs through the API
body:
### Summary

As purge, I want to list packs through the GitHub contents API, so that a scheduled run needs no full clone.

### Completion Goal

1. [api-trace] state: the fake GitHub serving a ledger tree with three packs; expected: the listing returns the three pack paths

### Measure

Completion Goal criteria observed

### Threshold

all 1 criteria

### Scenario

Serve a recorded ledger tree and list it.

### Environment

local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production
